Frequency once per day

Trigger You reduce a creature to 0 Hit Points with a Rite or a Strike.

Gain 1 Zeal, which may exceed your normal maximum by 1 point; excess is lost after 1 minute. Something in you is always a little hungry, and Gluttoneth likes it that way.
